objective: Search for 'Generative AI' on Google News and filter results by Past Hour.
notes: Ensure to navigate to the News section and apply the filter.

steps.title: Search for 'Generative AI'
steps.action: Enter 'Generative AI' in the search bar and submit the search.
steps.expected_result: Search results for 'Generative AI' are displayed.

steps.title: Filter results by Past Hour
steps.action: Select the filter option for 'Past Hour'.
steps.expected_result: Results are filtered to show articles from the past hour.

success_criteria: Search results for 'Generative AI' are shown.
Results are filtered to show only articles from the past hour.
